description: Returns up to ten of the tightest major aspects between two people's birth charts, each with a short meaning, and a reading for one relationship setting built from the planets that setting weighs. Each person is given by birth date, optional birth time and a place.

context.description: Relationship setting for the reading: dating, marriage, friendship, family or work. Dating when omitted.

birthDate.description: Birth date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100.

birthTime.description: Local birth time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock. Without it the chart keeps every sign possible that day.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in degrees, north positive.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in degrees, east positive.

place.description: A city from the website's list of 67 places, in any letter case, such as London, New York, Tokyo, Sydney or Mumbai.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name such as Europe/London, used instead of a city's zone.
